purpose: External sprite-art delivery; integration not authorized
exportPolicy: Native camera magnification is calibrated offline by uniform whole-image resampling and translation; never runtime per-frame scaling, body-part stretching, blade stretching, or alpha-bounds resizing.
groundPolicy: Grounded sole/body contact at canonical y448; low-alpha antialias fringe may extend below. KO foreground handguard may extend to y456 without clipping. Ground is a registration line, not an alpha clipping boundary.
airbornePolicy: Virtual lowest-boot root remains registered to y448. Existing physics determines world altitude. Review sheets raise airborne world roots about36logical pixels for demonstration only; never bake that lift into sprites or add it to jump physics.
runtimeSamplingReview: Retain alpha-aware rendering and assess the fine steel point on light/dark backgrounds and device pixel ratios. Do not introduce trimming, filtered-edge halos, or inconsistent frame origins.
phasePolicy: Light and Heavy share all initial attack textures; bind artwork to existing authoritative state/phase timers. Block uses Guard; no landing or victory textures.

memory.excludes: previews, duplicate GPU copies, atlasing/padding, driver overhead and native source art

approvalGate: Planner reviews assets/risks and separately authorizes Developer integration. Designer does not modify game files.
